enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Lie on back. Move arm. Turn to stomach. Reach for blanket. Adjust head. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Sleep.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash hands with soap. Rinse hands. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk into kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out cereal box. Take out bowl. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Sip milk. Stand up. Place bowl in sink. Rinse bowl. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on socks. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Button shirt. Zip pants. Buckle belt. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to workstation.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workstation. Pick up patient chart. Review notes. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Measure blood pressure. Record data. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to next patient. Repeat tasks. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Complete paperwork. Attend meeting. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home. Remove shoes. Greet family. Walk to living room.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Turn on stove. Put pan on stove. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Carry plate to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Rinse plate. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Type on keyboard. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Return to living room. Sit down. Continue watching TV. Use computer. Turn off TV. Close laptop. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Lie on back. Move arm. Turn to stomach. Reach for blanket. Adjust head. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Sleep.
